# GitHub issue forms

Structured issue templates for bugs, features, documentation, and lab requests.

| Template        | File                                     |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| Bug report      | [bug.yml](./bug.yml)                     |
| Feature request | [feature.yml](./feature.yml)             |
| Documentation   | [documentation.yml](./documentation.yml) |
| Lab request     | [lab-request.yml](./lab-request.yml)     |
| Chooser config  | [config.yml](./config.yml)               |

Owner setup checklist: [docs/maintainers/manual-github-settings.md](../../docs/maintainers/manual-github-settings.md)
